title: Spectacular sunset from offshore by yacht
text:
Our two hour sailing trip on the Gavina boat to watch the sunset in Barcelona was undoubtedly the highlight of our trip to this city. It has been an absolutely perfect experience from start to finish, well above our initial expectations.
La Gavina is a beautiful boat, very well maintained and ideally sized for our group. The views of the Barcelona skyline were simply spectacular. We could see how the sun was setting behind the mountain (I think we told you it is called Tibidabo), with orange tones that reflected in the sea, it was a truly magical moment.
Another of the attractions of this excu
